test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Everyone who studies forests knows trees have been dying in large and ________ numbers.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Massive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is:** 'Massive'.**
 
• **In the context** of the sentence, the author is trying to convey that a large number of trees have been dying. 
 
• Therefore, the word** "massive"** is the most appropriate choice as it emphasizes the vast scale or amount.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**Everyone who studies forests knows trees have been dying in large and massive numbers.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Minority:** This term is often used to refer to a smaller group or number within a larger population or set. However, in this context, we are trying to highlight a large amount, so "minority" would not fit.
 
• **Scanty: **This term means small or insufficient in quantity or amount. Again, this term wouldn't fit here because we're trying to emphasize a large amount.
 
• **Peculiar:** This term means strange or odd, which doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
